title: MZ SRPG Gear MZ - How to Move the Actor Closer

posts.author: Zeq
posts.body:
SRPG Gear MZ​
Hi friends, it's been awhile since i tinker with RPG Maker. Alright, I have just come back, and sort of decided to make a game something like FF Tactics/Fire Emblem. My question/problem is, I'm using SRPG Gear MZ, how do I make the actor, when transition into sideview battle system, move closer approaching the enemies when melee attacking, instead of just step one step forward?
